from_quote: his modified and reſtrained power muſt give way to the ſenſe of two-thirds of the legiſlature
rationale: The paragraph describes the President's power over legislation as one that "must give way to the sense of two-thirds of the legislature" and as a duty "to request both houses to re-consider"; this is the presentment and return of bills in Article I, Section 7, Clause 2.

from_quote: Our Preſident muſt be matured by the experience of years, and being born among us, his character at thirty-five muſt be fully underſtood
rationale: The paragraph says the President must be of mature age, "born among us," and thirty-five, the natural-born citizen and age qualifications of Article II, Section 1, Clause 5.
to_quote: No Person except a natural born Citizen

from_quote: He will have no authority to make a treaty, without two thirds of the ſenate, nor can he appoint ambaſſadors or other great officers without their approbation
rationale: The paragraph states that the President cannot make a treaty without two thirds of the Senate or appoint ambassadors and other officers without the Senate's approval, which is the content of Article II, Section 2, Clause 2.

rationale: The paragraph says the President "can create no nobility or titles of honour," which names the prohibition on titles of nobility in Article I, Section 9, Clause 8.
